outputs.justification: Manuscript states the MS proteomics data were deposited under PXD054522 via jPOSTrepo (see article). I attempted to locate a public ProteomeXchange/ProteomeCentral (PRIDE/jPOST) landing page for PXD054522 but could not find a public dataset page for that identifier at ProteomeCentral or the usual member repositories. This suggests the PXD entry is not publicly announced/accessible (may still be private or pending release). ([link.springer.com](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1038/s44319-026-00690-y?utm_source=openai))
